# 3 bed bungalow for sale

> This beautiful 3-bedroom residence is exceptionally well located in the scenic countryside of Kilcurry. The property measures approximately c.212.5 square meters (c. 2,287.3 sq.ft.) and stands on a 3.8 Acres elevated site. The property has spacious and comfortable living accommodation together with a floored attic and mature gardens with a neighbouring tree-lined shelterbelt.

- Lokalita: Falmore , Kilcurry, Dundalk
